core_obligations: Reduction: by construction it suffices to prove the claims when f is an open immersion and when f is proper (proof lines 3776-3777).
Open immersion case: j_! is a left adjoint to pullback j^{-1} and hence commutes with direct sums, by the adjointness lemma (proof lines 3777-3781).

Proper case: Rf_! = Rf_*; the result follows from the bounded below direct sum pushforward lemma in the bounded below case and from the proper mod n direct sums lemma when Lambda is torsion (proof lines 3782-3787).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to open immersions and proper morphisms (proof lines 3776-3777).
Open immersion case via adjointness (proof lines 3777-3781).
Proper case via two direct sum lemmas (proof lines 3782-3787).
